title: 第7章 暗流下的微光 上第8章 暗流下的微光 中
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
刘叙白回到青石镇的时候，日头刚刚偏西。
镇口那棵被雪压垮半边枝杈的老槐树下，蹲着几个晒太阳的闲汉。看见刘叙白走过来，几个人的目光齐刷刷地落在他腰间那柄裂了纹的精铁长剑上，眼神里带着一种说不清道不明的意味——敬畏、好奇，还有一点看热闹不嫌事大的兴奋。
阴阳门演武场上的事，传得比他走路还快。
青石镇就这么大，镇上但凡有点风吹草动，一顿饭的工夫就能传遍两条街。更何况是一个散修登门挑战宗门弟子这种事——在青石镇的历史上，往前数十年都未必能找出第二桩。刘叙白还没走到镇子中央，已经有七八个人装作不经意地从他身边经过，偷偷打量他腰间那柄裂纹剑，然后快步走开，交头接耳。
刘叙白没理会那些目光，径直穿过了镇子。
推开院门的时候，他第一眼看到的是苏清欢。她坐在院子里的石墩上，青锋剑横在膝头，面前摊着一块磨刀石和一小碟清水，正在不紧不慢地磨剑。剑身在磨刀石上来回滑动，发出细细的沙沙声，节奏稳定得像心跳。她听到门响，抬起头来，目光在刘叙白身上停了一息，然后落在他腰间那柄裂纹剑上。
“剑断了。”她说，语气平淡，像是在说今天天气不错。
“还能用。”刘叙白把裂纹剑解下来放在石桌上，在旁边坐下，“不过下次就不一定了。”
苏清欢放下手里的活计，拿起那柄裂纹剑翻看了一遍。她的手指沿着剑身上的裂纹轻轻划过，从剑刃一直摸到剑脊，然后放下剑，说了句：“凡铁承受不住《悟道剑诀》的发力方式。你需要一柄灵器。”
刘叙白苦笑了一声。灵器。墟市里当然有灵器，最便宜的一柄下品灵器也要至少两百枚下品灵石，这个数字对他来说跟天文数字差不多。他刚把全部身家砸在了破障晶上，现在兜里干净得能当镜子照。
“灵器的事以后再想办法。眼下更棘手的是粮食。”刘叙白揉了揉太阳穴，语气里带上了几分无奈，“我身上的灵石用光了，之前剩下的一点干粮也吃完了。今晚的晚饭还没着落。”
苏清欢看了他一眼，从腰间解下一个巴掌大的锦囊，放在石桌上推了过去。锦囊落在石板上的声音很轻，但听在刘叙白耳朵里却格外清脆——那是灵石碰撞的声响。
“这里面有十八枚下品灵石。”苏清欢说，“是之前你给我的那十枚，加上我以前攒的一点。不多，够撑几天。”
刘叙白看着那个锦囊，没有伸手去拿。那十枚灵石是他给苏清欢让她买药和衣物的，她没花完他知道，但没想到她会把剩下的全拿出来。至于她以前攒的那些——一个从大宗门流落出来的女子，身上仅剩的家底，不用想也知道有多珍贵。
“这是你全部的钱。”他说。
“嗯。”
“给了我你怎么办？”
苏清欢低下头继续磨剑，剑身在磨刀石上滑过，沙沙的声音填满了两个人之间的沉默。过了好一会儿，她才开口，声音比之前轻了几分，但语气还是那副波澜不惊的样子：“在黑松林，我中了蛇毒的时候，你没有问我值不值得救。现在你问我怎么办？”
刘叙白张了张嘴，想说什么，最终什么都没说出来。他把锦囊收起来，在手里攥了一会儿，然后从里面数出五枚灵石，把剩下的推了回去。
“五枚够买吃的了。剩下的你留着，当备用。”

苏清欢看了他一眼，没有推辞，把锦囊收回了腰间。她低下头继续磨剑，沙沙的声音又重新响了起来，但刘叙白注意到她嘴角的弧度比刚才柔和了一点点——只有一点点，不仔细看根本看不出来。
“今晚吃什么？”苏清欢头也不抬地问。
刘叙白想了想，站起来拍了拍身上的土：“镇上王屠户的肉铺这个时辰应该还有剩的骨头，买两根棒骨回来炖汤，再去老孙头家讨两根萝卜。天冷，喝口热乎的。”
他说着就往院门口走，走到门口又回过头来补了一句：“对了，陈砚走之前在他屋里藏了半坛子酒，回头我给找出来。”
苏清欢停下磨剑的手，抬头看了他一眼，嘴角那点弧度又明显了几分。她没有说话，但刘叙白从她眼神里读出了三个字——别独吞。
青石镇的傍晚来得很快。刘叙白从王屠户手里花三枚灵石买了三根棒骨——王屠户听说他在阴阳门的事之后，硬是多塞了一根，说什么“给咱镇上的人争了口气”。他又去老孙头家讨了两根白萝卜和一把干菇，路过镇上的烧饼铺子时顺手买了四个烧饼。回到院子里的时候，苏清欢已经把灶台收拾干净了，铁锅里烧着半锅水，正咕嘟咕嘟地冒着热气。
刘叙白把棒骨剁成小段焯了水，萝卜切成滚刀块，和干菇一起丢进锅里，又从墙角的瓦罐里捏了一小撮粗盐撒进去。盖上锅盖之后，灶膛里的柴火烧得正旺，橘红色的火光映在院墙上，把两个人的影子拉得忽长忽短。不一会儿锅盖缝里就开始往外冒白气，骨头汤的香味混着萝卜的清甜，在这个破败的小院子里一点一点弥漫开来。
“陈砚那坛子酒找到了。”刘叙白从陈砚屋里出来，手里拎着一个灰扑扑的陶坛，晃了晃，里面传出半满的水声，“半坛，够喝一顿的。”
他在石桌旁坐下，倒了两碗酒。酒是镇上土法酿的高粱酒，颜色浑浊，闻着冲鼻子，但在这寒冬腊月里，能有口酒喝已经是不错的享受了。锅里的骨头汤也炖好了，刘叙白盛了两大碗端上桌，汤色奶白，萝卜炖得半透明，干菇吸饱了汤汁胀得圆鼓鼓的，虽然只放了盐和几片老姜，但在这个物资匮乏的冬天，这已经是难得的热乎饭了。
两人就着骨头汤，一人掰了俩烧饼泡在汤里，间或喝一口劣酒。苏清欢吃东西的样子很安静，小口小口地喝汤，咬烧饼的时候几乎没有声音。刘叙白看着她，忽然觉得这个画面有些不可思议——几天前在黑松林里，这个女人拔剑破路的时候凌厉得像一柄出鞘的剑，而现在她坐在一个破院子里，端着一碗骨头汤，吃相甚至称得上斯文。
“看什么？”苏清欢头也不抬。
“没什么。”刘叙白移开目光，端起酒碗灌了一口，“就是觉得你这人挺有意思。能拿剑杀人，也能安安静静喝汤。”
苏清欢放下汤碗，拿筷子夹了一块萝卜，吹了吹上面的热气，慢条斯理地吃完之后才说：“拿剑是为了活命。喝汤也是为了活命。没有区别。”
刘叙白想了想，觉得她说得对，又觉得哪里不太对，但一时半会也说不清哪里不对。他索性不再多想，又喝了一口酒。劣酒辣嗓子，但那股热乎劲从喉咙一路烧到胃里，在寒冬里格外熨帖。

content_en:
When Liu Xubai returned to Qingshi Town, the sun had just turned west.
Under the old locust tree at the entrance of the town, half of its branches weighed down by snow, squatted a few idle men basking in the sun. Seeing Liu Xubai coming over, several people's eyes fell on the cracked fine iron sword on his waist. There was an indescribable meaning in their eyes - awe, curiosity, and a little excitement that was not too big to watch.
News of what happened at the Yin Yang Gate martial arts arena spread faster than he could walk.
Qingshi Town is just that big. If there is any disturbance in the town, it can spread to two streets in one meal. What's more, it's the case of a casual cultivator coming to challenge the sect's disciples - in the history of Qingshi Town, there may not be another one that can be found in the past few decades. Before Liu Xubai reached the center of the town, seven or eight people had already passed by him pretending to be casual, secretly looking at the cracked sword on his waist, and then walked away quickly, whispering to each other.
Liu Xubai ignored those glances and walked straight through the town.
When he pushed open the courtyard door, the first thing he saw was Su Qinghuan. She was sitting on the stone pier in the yard, with the Qingfeng sword across her knees. There was a whetstone and a small dish of water in front of her, and she was sharpening the sword slowly. The sword slid back and forth on the whetstone, making a thin rustling sound, and the rhythm was as steady as a heartbeat. She heard the door knock, raised her head, her eyes paused on Liu Xubai for a moment, and then fell on the cracked sword at his waist.
"The sword is broken," she said, her tone flat, as if she was saying the weather was nice today.
"It can still be used." Liu Xubai took off the cracked sword and placed it on the stone table, then sat down next to it, "But it won't be possible next time."
Su Qinghuan put down her work, picked up the cracked sword and looked through it. She lightly traced her fingers along the cracks on the sword, from the blade to the spine. Then she put the sword down and said, "Fan Tie can't bear the power of the Enlightenment Sword Art. You need a spiritual weapon."
Liu Xubai smiled bitterly. Spiritual weapon. Of course there are spiritual weapons in the market, and the cheapest low-grade spiritual weapon requires at least two hundred low-grade spiritual stones. This number is almost astronomical to him. He just spent all his wealth on the barrier-breaking crystal, and now his pocket is so clean that it can be used as a mirror.
"We'll figure out a solution for the spiritual weapon later. The more difficult thing right now is food." Liu Xubai rubbed his temples, with a hint of helplessness in his tone, "I've used up all the spiritual stones on my body, and I've also used up the little dry food I had left. I haven't received tonight's dinner yet."
Su Qinghuan glanced at him, took off a palm-sized brocade bag from her waist, placed it on the stone table and pushed it over. The sound of the kit falling on the stone slab was very soft, but it was particularly clear to Liu Xubai's ears - it was the sound of the collision of spiritual stones.
"There are eighteen low-grade spiritual stones in here." Su Qinghuan said, "It's the ten you gave me before, plus a little I saved before. It's not much, enough to last a few days."
Liu Xubai looked at the kit and did not reach out to take it. He gave Su Qinghuan the ten spiritual stones to buy medicine and clothes for her. He knew that she hadn't spent them all, but he didn't expect that she would take out all the rest. As for the things she had saved before - a woman who had been exiled from a large sect, and the only wealth she had left, it didn't take much to think about how precious it was.
"This is all your money," he said.
"Yeah."
"What will you do if you give it to me?"
Su Qinghuan lowered his head and continued to sharpen his sword. The sword slid across the whetstone, and the rustling sound filled the silence between the two people. After a while, she spoke, her voice a little softer than before, but her tone was still calm: "In the black pine forest, when I was poisoned by snake venom, you didn't ask me if I was worth saving. Now you ask me what should I do?"
Liu Xubai opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but in the end nothing came out. He put the kit away and held it in his hand for a while, then counted five spiritual stones from it and pushed the rest back.
"Five is enough to buyGot something to eat. You keep the rest as a spare. "
Su Qinghuan glanced at him and put the kit back into her waist without refusing. She lowered her head and continued to sharpen her sword, and the rustling sound came again, but Liu Xubai noticed that the curvature of the corners of her mouth was a little softer than before - only a little, and you couldn't tell it without looking carefully.
"What's for dinner tonight? Su Qinghuan asked without raising her head.
Liu Xubai thought for a moment, then stood up and patted the dirt on his body: "Butcher Wang's butcher shop in town should have some bones left at this time. Buy two stick bones and bring them back to make soup, and then go to Lao Suntou's house to ask for two radishes. It's cold, but it's warm to drink. "
As he spoke, he walked towards the door of the courtyard. When he reached the door, he turned around and added: "By the way, Chen Yan hid half a jar of wine in his room before he left. I'll find it later. "
Su Qinghuan stopped sharpening her sword and looked up at him. The curve of the corner of her mouth became more obvious. She didn't speak, but Liu Xubai read three words from her eyes - don't take it all to yourself.
The evening in Qingshi Town came quickly. Liu Xubai spent three spirit stones to buy three rod bones from Butcher Wang. After Butcher Wang heard about what happened to him at the Yin and Yang Gate, he just bought an extra one, saying "it will give the people in our town some peace of mind." He went to Lao Suntou's house to beg for two white radishes and a handful of dried mushrooms, and bought four sesame cakes when passing by a sesame cake shop in the town. When she returned to the yard, Su Qinghuan had already cleaned the stove. There was half a pot of water boiling in the iron pot, which was steaming.
Liu Xubai chopped the stick bones into small pieces and blanched them in water, cut the radish into hob pieces, and threw them into the pot together with the dried mushrooms. He also pinched a pinch of coarse salt from the earthen pot in the corner and sprinkled it in. After closing the pot lid, the firewood in the stove was burning brightly, and the orange-red firelight reflected on the courtyard wall, making the shadows of the two people grow longer and shorter. After a while, white steam began to come out from the cracks in the pot lid, and the aroma of bone soup mixed with the sweetness of radish spread little by little in this dilapidated little yard.
"Chen Yan's jar of wine was found. "Liu Xubai came out of Chen Yan's house, holding a dusty pottery jar in his hand. He shook it and heard the sound of half-full water, "Half jar, enough for a meal." "
He sat down at the stone table and poured two bowls of wine. The wine is sorghum wine brewed locally in the town. It is turbid in color and smells harsh to the nose, but in this cold winter, it is a good enjoyment to have a sip of wine. The bone soup in the pot was also simmered, and Liu Xubai filled two large bowls and brought it to the table. The color of the soup was milky white, and the radish was stewed translucent. The dried mushrooms were swollen after absorbing the soup. Although only salt and a few slices of ginger were added, it was already a rare warm meal in this winter when supplies were scarce.
The two of them drank bone soup, one person broke off two sesame seed cakes and soaked them in the soup, and occasionally took a sip of bad wine. Su Qinghuan ate very quietly, sipping the soup in small sips, and making almost no sound when biting the sesame seed cakes. Liu Xubai looked at her and suddenly felt that this scene was a bit incredible - a few days ago in the black pine forest, this woman was as sharp as an unsheathed sword when she drew her sword to break the road, and now she was sitting in a dilapidated yard, holding a bowl of bone soup, and her eating appearance was even elegant.
"What are you looking at? "Su Qinghuan didn't even raise her head.
"Nothing. Liu Xubai looked away, picked up the wine bowl and took a sip, "I just think you are quite interesting." He can kill with a sword, but he can also drink soup quietly. "
Su Qinghuan put down the soup bowl, picked up a piece of radish with chopsticks, blew the hot air on it, and after eating slowly, she said: "The sword is for survival. Drinking soup is also to survive. There is no difference. "
Liu Xubai thought for a while and felt that what she said was right, but also felt that something was wrong, but he couldn't tell what was wrong for a while. He simply stopped thinking about it and took another sip of wine. Bad wine burns the throat, but the heat burns from the throat all the way to the stomach, which is particularly refreshing in the cold winter.
